messages.author: f3efe76710f72d8e
messages.subject: Precision matrix for AR(1)
parts:
Hi 
I am using AR(1) for modeling a spatio-temporal process, actually in the paper by title  "Spatio-temporal modeling of particulate matter
concentration through the SPDE approach", Cammelettie etal.,  i want to know some 
details about calculation for Precision matrix for َthe CAR model:    x_t=a(x_t-1)+epsilon_t

How the variance of x1 equal to sigma^2/1-a^2 is calculated?


Thank you

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Precision matrix for AR(1)
parts:
Hi,

If you want to understand the AR1 structure and precision matrix, I suggest
https://haakonbakka.bitbucket.io/btopic120.html

The variance can be computed e.g. numerically by just inverting the precision matrix.

Kind regards,
Haakon

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Precision matrix for AR(1)
parts:
you can also check out any book on timeseries, with

x_t = phi * x_t + eps_t

then at stationarity,

Var(x) = phi^2 * Var(x) + Var(eps)

and there you go...
